atoms.text: According to researchers, <mat>14%</mat> of adult UK citizens do not have a passport.

atoms.a: What decimal represents the number of UK citizens without a passport?
Now select the fraction that represents the same number.

atoms.text: Most US citizens travel within the mainland of the USA. However, compared to previous years, the portion of Americans traveling internationally increased by a rate of 0.04.

atoms.a: Now select the fraction that represents the increase.

atoms.text: Around <mat>74%</mat> of travelling in the US is for leisure, leaving <mat>26%</mat> for other reasons.

atoms.a: What decimal represents travelling for leisure?
Which two fractions represent travelling for other reasons?

atoms.text: In the US, national parks are a very popular travel destination. Yellowstone was declared a national park in 1872, making it the oldest national park in the US. The land of the park stretches over three states: <mat>96%</mat> in Wyoming, <mat>3%</mat> in Montana and <mat>1%</mat> in Idaho.

atoms.a: What decimal represents the national park’s area in Idaho?
What fraction represents the area in Montana?

atoms.text: According to travel.anton, 32 million US citizens visited Mexico in 2017. Cancún, a city in the north-east of Mexico, attracts <mat>1/3</mat> of the American tourists because of the city’s beautiful beaches, delicious food and great weather.
